state_breaks.detail: Trinity's physical register: ev-001 exits her 'physically unharmed' (physical.moved=false, exit 'Unhurt'), but ev-002 enters her as 'Uninjured (post-police-fight, pre-chase)' and then immediately breaks her body in the fall. The entry label 'post-police-fight' acknowledges the prior event, but neither node carries the wound-state across as a continuous baseline — the unharmed exit of ev-001 and the 'uninjured' entry of ev-002 are consistent, so no break; noted for reviewer only.

Trinity's knowledge register: ev-002 keeps her 'Does not know the informant has already given the Agents the crew's next target' (moved=false) across the whole event, while ev-001's affects_outside and ev-002's affects_outside both establish the betrayal as the off-screen engine. This is not a break between the two nodes (both agree she is ignorant), but the entity's ignorance is sustained by absence rather than continuity; flagged only because the surrounding events treat the betrayal as live.

contradictions.detail: The 'cops' (rooftop unit) in ev-002 enter 'Confident they have Trinity cornered at the edge of the roof,' but ev-001 records every police officer in Room 303 as dead ('All dead — none survive the gunfire'; BIG COP dead; 'the other cops' all dead). ev-002 introduces a fresh rooftop cop unit without stating it is distinct from the Room 303 squad, so a reader could read the two as the same force — one node says the cops are all dead, the other says cops are confidently pursuing. The POLICE entity in ev-002 also enters 'already beaten once by Trinity,' gesturing at the Room 303 deaths, yet treats its own unit as an unbroken continuing pursuer. This is a contradiction in the identity/continuity of the police force across the join that neither node resolves.

missing_links.detail: ev-001 ends with Smith heading for the alley and Brown entering the hotel to 'secure the target.' ev-002 opens with Brown 'Entering the hotel hall leading another unit of police' and Smith arriving only at the end over the smashed booth. The outward effect ev-001 claims (Agents moving in to hunt/capture Trinity) is plainly realised in ev-002 (Brown leads the rooftop pursuit; the unit corners her), but neither node states that the takeover at the end of ev-001 is what initiates the pursuit in ev-002 — the hand-off from 'Agents now own the operation' to 'Agents physically chasing' is left implicit.

ev-001's affects_outside states 'The raid's failure... convert the story from containment to pursuit: Trinity is now a confirmed, uncatchable target the Agents must hunt.' ev-002 realises exactly this (the rooftop chase, Brown matching her leap, the hunt turning to Neo), but ev-002's entry does not acknowledge that this pursuit is the consequence ev-001 announced; the enabling effect is claimed by ev-001 and executed by ev-002 without either naming the link.

state_breaks.detail: Neo's knowledge register: ev-003 exit leaves him holding a named quest and knowing the pursuit is real — he has been told by Trinity 'They're watching you' and that he is 'in danger,' and that the resistance is 'looking for him.' Yet ev-004's knowledge exit states he 'still does not know who they are or what they want with him,' and his safety/relational exits treat the raid as an unidentified threat. The named, identified danger from ev-003 (Trinity warning him of watchers) is not carried forward or reconciled with his apparent ignorance of who is hunting him.

Neo's emotional register: ev-003 exit has him 'committed to the quest' — 'star-struck, drugged receptivity,' pulled in and willing. Yet ev-004's emotional exit presents 'broken nerve' — 'This is insane! I can't do this!' — a collapse of commitment. Nothing in ev-004's recorded change accounts for the reversal from committed receptivity to a nerve that breaks; the change field describes terror during flight but not the undoing of the prior commitment.

missing_links.detail: ev-003 affects_outside.off_screen_reactor states the Agents 'already have The name is Neo' (sc-011) and that this event makes him 'easier to track.' ev-004 realises exactly this: the Agents raid the office floor knowing to close on Neo's cubicle, and a female employee points out his location. Neither node's connective tissue states that ev-003's advance of the pursuit (a named, moving target) is what enables the precise, cubicle-level raid in ev-004.

state_breaks.detail: Neo's 'knowledge' exit in ev-004 is that he 'still does not know who they are or what they want with him,' but ev-005 opens with him confidently asserting legal rights against 'a human lawman' — he appears to have concluded the pursuers are ordinary police, a resolution the capture scene never delivers (he was cornered aware he could not name his hunters).

Neo's 'relational' exit in ev-004 is 'Alone — Morpheus has hung up, the escape has failed, and he is surrounded by the authorities he was fleeing,' yet ev-005's entry describes him as 'Fleeing on foot through the office building' (positional/status) — the transition from trapped-and-captured to actively fleeing again is not accounted for.

contradictions.detail: ev-004 ends with Neo cornered in the office with a cop opening the door and his escape route gone, but ev-005's Neo entries (positional, status) describe him as 'Fleeing on foot through the office building' — the two nodes disagree about whether Neo was captured at the office or still in flight when the later event begins.

missing_links.detail: ev-004's affects_outside states the failed escape 'delivers him into the Agents' custody, setting up the interrogation,' and ev-005 realises exactly that (Neo seized, forced into the sedan, interrogated), but neither node's state triples narrate the actual seizure/capture that bridges 'trapped in the office' to 'prisoner in the sedan.'

ev-004's affects_outside notes 'the reprimand establishes the ordinary world's authority as petty' and that Rhineheart's accusation of 'specialness' is 'about to become true,' but ev-005 contains no Rhineheart node and does not register this thread — the reprimand's planted beat is dropped without acknowledgment.

state_breaks.detail: In ev-005 Neo exits with his mouth sealed shut and a fiber-optic wire-tap creature burrowed into his navel (physical register: 'Mouthless and implanted — unable to speak, with a tracking device inside his body'). ev-006 opens with Neo woken screaming from a nightmare, 'briefly reassured his body is intact at home,' and his physical change/exit describe only being jolted by the phone, held at gunpoint, and driven away — nothing accounts for the disappearance of the sealed mouth or the removal of the implanted creature. Neo enters ev-006 as physically intact, with no scene between the two events recording the restoration of his mouth or the extraction of the bug.

ev-005 exits Neo as a prisoner in the Agents' custody, physically pinned in the interrogation room (status/positional registers). ev-006 opens with Neo alone in his bed at home, then on the rain-soaked street. No scene accounts for his release from the Agents' custody and return to his apartment.

ev-005 exits Neo in 'panic and bottomless dread, his bravado stripped away' (emotional register). ev-006 opens with Neo 'raw and destabilized — terror, then brief relief, then dread,' including a 'brief relief' upon being reassured his body is intact at home. The relief and the return home are unaccounted for by any transition between the two events.

contradictions.detail: ev-005's affects_outside states the implanted bug 'give[s] the Agents a means to track him ... so the violation becomes the physical debt the story must later repay,' and the off-screen reactor note has Trinity knowing Neo was captured. ev-006's affects_outside instead lists 'the extraction of the tracking bug from Neo's body' as a downstream enablement and names the Agents as having 'lost their quarry.' These are not strictly contradictory in themselves, but ev-006's summary and triples treat Neo as free at home with no bug present, directly contradicting ev-005's exit state in which the bug is freshly implanted and Neo is in custody — the two nodes disagree about whether Neo is captured/bugged or free/intact at the join.

missing_links.detail: ev-005's affects_outside explicitly claims the implanted bug 'becomes the physical debt the story must later repay' and that Trinity, now aware of the capture, will be 'press[ed] ... to act on his behalf off-screen.' ev-006 plainly realises both — the bug is extracted from Neo's body by the crew, and Trinity's car collects him — yet neither node's triples nor summary states that Trinity's off-screen intervention (between the events) secured Neo's release from the Agents and enabled his return home, nor that the bug extraction repays the debt set up in ev-005. The causal bridge (Trinity's rescue + bug removal) is claimed by the earlier event and realised by the later, but neither says so.

state_breaks.detail: Neo's safety register: ev-007 exits him in cardiac arrest, blacking out while the operation 'races to complete the lock' before he dies; ev-008 enters him as a body 'fighting blindly against the gelatin, unable to breathe' inside the sealed pod. Nothing accounts for the transition from flatlined arrest to a struggling, oxygen-starved-but-alive body — the completion of the lock/extraction is implied by ev-007's 'operation races to complete the lock' but the state flip from dead-dying to actively struggling is left unbridged.

Neo's physical register: ev-007 exits him unconscious ('blacking out', 'agony of arrest'); ev-008 enters him actively 'ruptures the shroud', 'tears himself free', 'fighting blindly against the gelatin'. No account is given of how a blacked-out, arrested man regained the consciousness and strength to rupture the pod — the 'operation completes the lock' is claimed in ev-007's affects but the physical recovery is unbridged.

Neo physical: ev-008 exits 'passed out on the floor of the hovercraft,' while ev-009 opens with him 'recovered from the sewer' and being operated on an operating table. The move from hovercraft floor back to the sewer (and then to the operating table) is not recorded in either node.

Neo positional: ev-008 exits 'passed out on the floor of the hovercraft,' while ev-009's entry/position register places him on an 'operating table' being worked on. The transfer between these positions is not accounted for.

Neo safety: ev-008 exits with his fate 'freed or harvested' explicitly undetermined, while ev-009 opens with him safely in the custody of a rebuild crew. The resolution of the harvest-or-free ambiguity is not recorded.

contradictions.detail: Morpheus knowledge (ev-009) states his certainty is 'without hedging' and unshakable, while the affects_outside note for the same event calls his certainty 'over-extended' and describes a 'crack' (the exact year). These are in tension — one asserts no doubt, the other asserts a flaw — though both are within ev-009 rather than across the join; flagged only as the strongest internal tension visible at the seam.

missing_links.detail: ev-008 affects_outside.off_screen_reactor explicitly flags that the machine may now treat Neo as a loose subject (harvest vs. lost) 'undetermined,' and ev-009 realises the resolution (Neo safely rebuilt aboard the ship) without either node stating that the machine's intent was settled or that the crew secured him against it. The enabling effect of ev-008 (removal from the machine system) is realised in ev-009's safe recovery but is never named as the connecting thread.

state_breaks.detail: ev-015 Neo 'relational' exit claims his trust in Morpheus is 'at its peak — pure and unquestioning,' but ev-014 records no prior establishment of that trust; Neo enters ev-015 as a struggling trainee who 'only half-believes and leans on authority,' with no earlier state in the pair accounting for a peak that the later event then treats as already reached and about to be tested.

ev-015 Trinity 'knowledge' exit has her briefing Neo on the Sentinel ('establishing herself as the crew's interpreter'), yet ev-014 leaves Trinity treating Cypher as a nuisance and never places her with Neo or in any teaching role; the later event's interpreter-of-Neo state has no prior footing in the pair.

ev-015 Trinity 'relational' exit has her 'treating Neo as someone worth protecting and educating,' but ev-014's Trinity is preoccupied with her own attachment and deflecting Cypher, with no movement toward Neo as a charge; the protective/educational stance appears without a prior state supporting it.

contradictions.detail: ev-015 Morpheus 'relational' exit states 'Neo remains dangerously uninformed about the Sentinel... a gap Morpheus does not close,' while ev-015 Dozer 'knowledge' and Trinity 'knowledge' exits record that Neo is briefed on the Sentinel ('Search and destroy' from Dozer, a definition from Trinity) — the later event both asserts the gap is unclosed and shows it being filled.

ev-015 Morpheus 'knowledge' exit says 'whether Tank answers is not shown,' but ev-015 Tank 'knowledge' entry already assumes 'Morpheus hails him via intercom but no reply is shown,' i.e. the later event's own Tank node presupposes the hail it is supposed to be realising, so the earlier Morpheus node's framing is redundant rather than causal — the pair cannot both be the first assertion of the unanswered hail.

missing_links.detail: ev-014 affects_outside 'enables' introduces the Oracle as the mechanism for verifying faith and sets up 'Morpheus's later decision to take Neo to her'; ev-015's Neo 'safety' exit casts him as 'the prophesied exception who will survive where others died' — the prophecy-verification thread ev-014 explicitly seeds is not picked up or acknowledged in the pair.

ev-014 Cypher 'safety'/'relational' exits move his dissent 'toward open betrayal' and seed 'the ideological grounds for his betrayal'; ev-015 blocks_or_costs notes 'a gap Cypher will exploit' in Neo's ignorance — the earlier event's planted betrayal thread is referenced downstream but no node in the pair carries Cypher's thread forward across the join.

state_breaks.detail: The Nebuchadnezzar is not present in ev-016, but its state at the end of ev-015 (powered down, cold, trapped/wedged in a tight supply line, E.M.P. armed) is not carried into ev-016, which opens with Cypher and Neo sharing drinks on the main deck under normal lighting and power. No register records the ship being powered back up, moved out of the pipe, or the E.M.P. being stood down, yet the later event's setting (a casual drink on a lit, powered main deck) requires that state. The transition is accounted for by neither node.

Cypher's positional register opens ev-017 with the entry 'Left on the ship while Morpheus takes the risk of going in (per earlier scenes),' but in ev-016 Cypher jacks into the Matrix (the restaurant meeting with Smith) and never returns to the ship. ev-016's exit state for Cypher is 'Seated across from Agent Smith in the Matrix,' so ev-017's entry of 'left on the ship' is unaccounted for — he is in two different Matrix locations with no recorded return and re-jack.

Cypher's safety register in ev-017 records moved:false with the change 'Cypher has already sold the crew and plants a live line as they depart; Cypher is aware,' yet the unchanged_because boilerplate states 'The danger is real but entirely concealed from Cypher; his felt safety cannot move on information he does not have.' This directly contradicts the change field, which says Cypher is aware — he is not conceiving danger from unknown information, he is the author of it.

contradictions.detail: Trinity's end state in ev-023 is 'phone yielded to Morpheus / it is now in Morpheus's control,' but ev-022 never shows Morpheus without a weapon and unarmed, and no scene in ev-022 places a phone in Trinity's hands or establishes her as the crew's phone-holder. The later event's entire relational/knowledge/safety pivot (Morpheus overriding Trinity and seizing her phone) has no anchor in the earlier event, which records only arming Neo, the cable cut, and Mouse's death.

state_breaks.detail: POLICE (ev-023) exits 'Poised to gain the crew's location through the now-active traceable phone' — the phone seized by Morpheus is expected to give pursuers a fix. In ev-024 the police arrive at the Hotel Lafayette and begin sweeping with no indication they have used any trace to locate the crew; the anticipated capability is simply absent. The nodes do not account for the phone-trace effect not materialising.

Morpheus's abandoned jacket is present in the hall in ev-026, but ev-025 places Morpheus (the crew's leader) being led to a spot on the eighth floor with no record of him removing or abandoning a jacket, and no record of the jacket's separation from him. Morpheus does not appear as an entity in ev-026, so nothing accounts for the jacket being left behind in the hall.

contradictions.detail: ev-026's summary and Brown's status register place Brown 'in the hall' demanding the fugitives' location, but his positional register in ev-025 states 'No scene records Brown moving from the stairwell' and his exit is 'In the stairwell, listening.' The later node realises him in the hall without any recorded move accounting for the relocation, and the unchanged positional register in ev-026 conflicts with his presence in the hall.

missing_links.detail: ev-025's affects_outside states the eighth-floor lockdown 'blocks_or_costs' the crew's clean exit and closes their window; ev-026 plainly realises this by having the fugitives abandon the room and escape through the walls. Neither node frames ev-026's escape as the direct consequence of the trap closing in ev-025.

state_breaks.detail: The earlier event ends with the fugitives concealed and descending inside the plumbing wall, having escaped Room 808 and lost their pursuers. The later event opens with the crew (including Neo, Trinity, Morpheus, Cypher) already hidden and stationary inside the walls of ROOM 608, under fire — with no triple in the later event accounting for the transit from Room 808's wall to Room 608's wall, nor for the pursuers having rediscovered and begun shooting into the structure they had just lost.

Agent Brown in the earlier event is reduced to interrogating an empty trail with no live target and only traces (the hole, the jacket). The later event has an Agent already inside the wall, strangling Neo — a leap from 'search lost its target' to 'agent physically engaged and about to kill' that no triple in the later event bridges (the later event's Agent Smith knowledge/positional entries begin from 'unexplained sound / not yet present,' not from Brown's cold-trail state).

contradictions.detail: The earlier event's knowledge register for the cops ends with them AWARE that the fugitives escaped by breaking through the wall (they 'come upon the man-sized hole' and 'learn the fugitives escaped'). The later event's opening (The cops / The Cop knowledge entries) has them 'finding no clue to the fugitives' whereabouts' and alerted only to 'an anomalous sound... source still unknown' — treating the fugitives' location as undiscovered. The later event does not reconcile how the cops, having found the breach in Room 808, are now searching Room 608 as if the trail were still blank; and it asserts the hiding place is 'undiscovered' by sound even though the earlier event already had the route exposed by the hole.

missing_links.detail: The earlier event's affects_outside.enables explicitly claims 'the fugitives' escape route through the walls is now open, so the pursuit loses its target and must follow a physical trail instead of a visible quarry.' The later event realises exactly this — the cops follow the physical trail (the strange sound in the plaster) rather than a visible quarry — but neither node states that the earlier event's opened wall-route is what put the cops onto the sound in Room 608; the enabling effect lands without being named as the cause.

state_breaks.detail: The Cop (ev-027) exits ev-027 'Frozen, body spasming, disarmed and helpless in the room' (positional/knowledge: he has located the fugitives in the wall and is being subdued by them). In ev-028 the crew is in an open boiler-room firefight with Trinity 'still searching for an exit' and everyone 'exposed to the firefight.' Nothing accounts for the Cop's transition from a subdued, frozen, disarmed man who had pinpointed the crew's hiding place to a boiler-room gunfight in which the crew is still unlocated and freely exchanging fire. The Cop's neutralisation (which should have ended the immediate threat) is neither resolved nor carried forward.

The crew's knowledge/safety continuity: at the end of ev-027 the Cop has discovered the crew inside the wall and is being attacked by it, yet ev-028 opens with the crew standing in an open boiler room 'still searching for an exit' under undifferentiated fire, as if the wall-discovery and the Cop's subdual never happened. No change bridges 'hidden occupants exposed and overpowering a cop' to 'crew in open firefight, exit still unfound.'

Dozer is alive and 'crying out' at the end of ev-031 (his knowledge exit), yet ev-031's own affects_outside/blocks_or_costs lists only Apoc, Switch, Tank, and Dozer as casualties — Dozer is not mentioned among the downed crew, and no register elsewhere in ev-031 accounts for his death. The 'safety' register asserts he is killed, but nothing in the event's causal chain or downstream accounting reflects it, and it is invisible to the earlier event's picture of a functioning ship.

ev-030 establishes Tank as the operator actively routing exits and the crew's only link to the ship; ev-031 opens with Cypher already in control of the operator station and Tank blasted/shot. Nothing in ev-030's affects_outside or ev-031's entries accounts for how Cypher got to the ship first and overpowered Tank before the crew arrived — the operator who was 'poised' to serve the exit in ev-030 is already a casualty at ev-031's entry with no bridging beat.

contradictions.detail: ev-030's affects_outside says the crew's suspicion of Cypher is 'filed rather than acted on,' and ev-031's Trinity register has her deceived into believing Cypher is a surviving crewmate reporting Tank's accident — consistent. But ev-031's Cypher 'status' entry states he was 'a crew member covertly arranging his own exit' at entry, while ev-030 already had him as an open betrayer who killed Dozer, shot Tank, and killed Apoc and Switch. ev-031 reverts Cypher to a pre-betrayal stance ('covertly arranging') that ev-030 had already superseded, contradicting the earlier event's established state of Cypher as an active, revealed killer operating from outside the ship.

missing_links.detail: ev-030's affects_outside enables 'the trap (ev-023) to close on a reassembled, off-guard crew' and names Cypher as the off-screen reactor 'positioned to carry out the betrayal against the ship.' ev-031 realises exactly this — Cypher reaches the ship, seizes the operator station, and begins killing crew — yet neither node states that Cypher's securing of the exit in ev-030 is what lets him reach the ship ahead of the crew and take the deck. The causal handoff from 'poised to leave' (ev-030) to 'in control of the ship' (ev-031) is realised but never articulated.

state_breaks.detail: ev-031 leaves Tank's survival explicitly unresolved at the scene level ('Tank's survival unresolved at scene level'), yet ev-032 enters with Tank up and operating the ship. The later event's own registers assert he 'survived (from prior event),' but the earlier event never records him surviving — it ends with him 'presumed killed' / survival unresolved. The gap between 'presumed dead / unresolved' and 'operating' is not accounted for across the join.

contradictions.detail: ev-031's affects_outside states 'Tank and Dozer are down (Tank's survival unresolved at scene level),' directly contradicting ev-032's Tank registers which premise 'having survived (from prior event).' The earlier node withholds confirmation the later node assumes as given.

state_breaks.detail: Agent Smith's emotional/knowledge entry state is described as 'the residue of the crack where his composure broke into personal hatred (earlier)' — a state that ev-033 explicitly did NOT reach (ev-033 records Smith as 'unbroken by the interruption,' 'coldly commanding,' and 'unaware of any threat'). The personal-hatred crack is imported from off-screen rather than accounted for across this join.

contradictions.detail: ev-033 ends with Morpheus's life signs in 'violent reaction' to a doubled dose while still actively resisting ('fighting to keep his reaction from becoming surrender'). ev-034 opens with him 'unconscious, inert' and his alpha pattern shifting from chaotic to ordered — the sign of breaking. The transition from violent struggle to inert near-break is not carried by any recorded event between the two nodes (the 'off_screen_reactor' in ev-033 even states Smith remains unaware and his control persists, implying continuity rather than the collapse that has in fact occurred). The deterioration is plausible but the connective tissue is absent from both nodes.

state_breaks.detail: Morpheus — physical register. In ev-034 his alpha pattern has just shifted from chaotic to an ordered symmetrical pattern (the sign he is about to break); in ev-035 his entry state is 'life signs running chaotic patterns' again, with no account of the reversal from ordered back to chaotic.

Morpheus — emotional register. In ev-034 he is recorded as having 'no readable emotion... unconscious and being dismantled'; in ev-035 he enters already 'sneering through the pain' and holding a contempt for Smith that is 'almost serene,' with no recorded transition from inert/unconscious to actively defiant.

Agent Smith — emotional register. In ev-034 his exit is 'order restored, the breach sealed over,' cold and aphoristic after forcing himself back into command; in ev-035 he enters as 'a composed Agent performing an interrogation, puzzled only that the serum fails,' with no account of the restored composure being lost again.

Agent Smith — status register. In ev-034 his exit is 'restored to absolute command,' having reasserted machine control and issued the sentinel order; in ev-035 he enters as 'composed lead Agent directing the interrogation' and then loses composure, with no account of the previously-restored control being undone.

contradictions.detail: Agent Smith's emotional trajectory. ev-034 ends with him having sealed his crack and restored cold order ('the breach sealed over'); ev-035 opens with him as a merely 'composed Agent... puzzled only that the serum fails,' treating him as if the crack had never happened and been repaired. The two cannot both be the immediate prior state of the same character without an account of the relapse.

The interrogation's status. ev-034 ends with Smith concluding the interrogation has reached a decision point and converting it into a physical hunt ('Deploy the sentinels'), i.e. the psychological operation is over; ev-035 opens with Smith still actively interrogating and deepening the interrogation. The two disagree on whether the interrogation is concluded or ongoing.

missing_links.detail: ev-034's off_screen_reactor states the Agents 'have deployed the sentinels to hunt the ship physically' and that this certainty is 'the blind spot the rescue will punish.' ev-035 realises the rescue launch (Neo and Trinity arming and jacking in) but neither node marks the sentinels-deployed threat as the connective tissue between the two, even though the earlier event explicitly frames it as the consequence the rescue runs against.

state_breaks.detail: Morpheus's `emotional` register is carried over verbatim from ev-035's exit ('Unbroken—holding a contempt for Smith that is almost serene, giving nothing') despite his `physical` register moving to a near-death, ashen, barely-conscious state. The serene, defiant contempt that defined his tortured-but-lucid exit in ev-035 is inconsistent with a man now 'too far gone to register what is said' (knowledge) and giving 'no readable emotional signal.' The state was inherited rather than re-evaluated against the new physical reality.

Morpheus `physical` exit in ev-035 is 'Bound and being actively tortured, held under a direct death threat' (mid-assault, body running 'chaotic patterns'), yet his ev-036 entry is 'Already gravely weakened — face ashen, like someone near death,' with no account of the transition from active struggle to post-torture collapse, the removal of bonds, or his extraction from the executive office to the ship's main deck. The intervening torture-ending, unbinding, and relocation are unaccounted for.

Morpheus `positional` exit in ev-035 is 'Bound and hunched in the executive office,' but his ev-036 entry places him 'On the main deck, lying or reclined' aboard the ship. Nothing in either node accounts for this relocation (extraction from the building), and his `safety`/`status` registers are marked unchanged across a move that is itself a major unrecorded event.

Tank `emotional` exit in ev-035 is 'Committed but clear-eyed about the near-suicidal odds—arming a just another guy as an act of desperate hope,' actively operating the jack-in; his ev-036 entry is 'Concerned but not yet outwardly engaged with Morpheus in this beat.' The shift from active, hopeful operator of the launched rescue to a detached watcher is unexplained, and 'not yet outwardly engaged' misreads his established role as Morpheus's devoted caretaker.

Tank `relational` exit in ev-035 is 'Along for the run—committed to arming Neo,' operating the jack-in; his ev-036 entry is 'Watching over Morpheus at a slight remove.' The move from arming the rescue team inside the Matrix to standing over the incapacitated Morpheus aboard the ship is unaccounted for, and 'at a slight remove' contradicts his just-established caretaker commitment.

Tank `positional` exit in ev-035 is 'Has jacked the team into the Matrix; positioned on the ship as their operator,' yet his ev-036 entry is 'Standing or otherwise occupied near Morpheus.' His relocation from the operator station to Morpheus's side is unrecorded.

contradictions.detail: ev-035 Tank `safety` exit is 'Aboard the ship, physically safe, operating the jack-in' (active), while ev-036 Tank `safety` entry is 'Safe aboard the ship, in a moment of relative stillness.' The 'relative stillness' contradicts the active jack-in operation that immediately precedes it; the launch of a near-suicidal rescue is not a moment of stillness. The nodes are incompatible on Tank's immediate state, and neither accounts for the shift from action to stillness.

ev-036 Morpheus `emotional` exit ('Unbroken—holding a contempt for Smith that is almost serene, giving nothing') is identical to his ev-035 exit, yet ev-036's own `knowledge` register states he is 'too far gone to register what is said' and the `emotional` change is 'None' because 'The scene gives no readable emotional signal from Morpheus.' The node simultaneously asserts a serene, defiant emotional state and denies any readable emotional signal, an internal contradiction.

state_breaks.detail: Morpheus's physical state. In ev-036 he is aboard the Nebuchadnezzar on the main deck, ashen and near death, with Tank keeping vigil over him. In ev-037 he is in the executive office of the Government Building, 'released but still held by the Agents,' with the Agents having 'just released the still-captive Morpheus.' He has moved from the ship to the building with nothing in either node accounting for the transfer. The ev-037 triples attribute the prior state to 'sc-154' rather than to ev-036's exit, so the handoff between these two adjacent events is unbridged.

Morpheus's safety/relational/status state. In ev-036 he is 'incapacitated and dependent on others to reach and recover him' — the object of a rescue, attended by Tank aboard the ship. In ev-037 he is 'Captive of the Agents, Smith his immediate captor,' held in the Government Building. The event that moved him from being a shipboard patient under Tank's watch to a released-yet-captive prisoner in the Agents' office is not recorded in either node.

contradictions.detail: Location of Morpheus. ev-036 places him on the Nebuchadnezzar's main deck (Tank sits beside him aboard ship); ev-037 places him in the Government Building's executive office in Agent custody. These are incompatible situated states for the same continuous character across two adjacent events with no transfer shown. (Same underlying rupture as the state_breaks above, surfaced here as a direct location contradiction.)

state_breaks.detail: Agent Smith's emotional/knowledge state at the ev-037 exit is 'shaken, in disbelief, alarm he could not yet name,' but he enters ev-038 'composed, interpreting the intruders analytically (framing them as trying to save him)' with nothing between the events to account for the recovery of composure or the crystallization of that interpretation.

Agent Brown enters ev-038 'still guessing' about the intruders' intent, contradicting his ev-037 exit where Jones has already told the room the attack is a rescue attempt and Brown is 'aware he is out of the loop' — the move from 'out of the loop' to 'still guessing' is unexplained, and treating the intrusion as ambiguous again regresses his prior positioning.

Agent Jones enters ev-038 'certain the attack is a rescue attempt' (his ev-037 exit), yet ev-038 frames him as only 'tracking the disturbance's origin' with no acknowledgment of that certainty — the informational lead he carried into the join is dropped.

Agent Jones is destroyed and reverted to the inert body of the PILOT at the end of ev-039 (physical/status/safety registers all read 'eliminated', 'inert', 'neutralized'), yet he enters ev-040 'alive, charging into the flooded Executive Office' with 'predatory momentum carried from the rooftop.' No triple accounts for an Agent reconstituting into a new host between the two events.

contradictions.detail: ev-039 ends with Jones destroyed and reverted to the inert PILOT body (no longer a threat, 'removed from the pursuit in this engagement'). ev-040 opens with Jones alive and leading the charge into the office as part of the three-Agent unit guarding Morpheus. The later node's entry state is incompatible with the earlier node's exit state, and the later node itself attributes his confidence to momentum 'carried from the rooftop' rather than to a reconstitution, deepening the incompatibility.

state_breaks.detail: Trinity (LATER) enters ev-041 'having just hauled Neo back from the edge' / 'just saved him,' but in ev-040 it is Neo who anchors Morpheus and self-rescues onto the gutter, while Trinity's rescue is of the whole craft and she ends dangling against a skyscraper. No triple records Trinity catching/hauling Neo specifically, so her entry-state as Neo's rescuer is unaccounted for by the earlier event.

The crew's positional state. ev-041 exits with Morpheus, Neo, and Trinity 'en route from the rooftop toward the subway exit (State and Balbo)' — they have not yet arrived. ev-042 opens with them already 'reaching the subway station' and exiting. The intervening transit (arrival at the subway) is not recorded in either node, leaving a small gap between 'moving toward' and 'arriving at' the exit. This is a minor, largely continuous break (they were already heading there), but no node accounts for the arrival itself.

Neo's safety register exits ev-042 as 'having escaped the immediate rooftop trap and begun exiting the Matrix via the subway phone' (i.e., in the act of leaving), yet he enters ev-044 still physically present in the subway station facing his pursuer. Nothing in either node accounts for why the exit that was underway did not complete.

Trinity's positional register exits ev-042 as a fugitive crew member moving toward the phone to exit the Matrix, yet she enters ev-044 established aboard the Nebuchadnezzar behind Tank. Neither node records her exit, so the relocation from subway to ship is unaccounted.

Morpheus's positional/safety registers exit ev-042 as having left the Matrix through the phone, yet he enters ev-044 aboard the Nebuchadnezzar. His actual exit is shown in ev-042, but the arrival aboard the ship is not recorded, leaving the transition partially unbridged.

Trinity's physical register does not move across ev-046 (unchanged_because: 'no change in her physical location'), yet her emotional register claims she 'moves from involuntary alarm... through calculation... to a direct protest' and her status register claims she 'moves to block it' — the nodes assert motion while simultaneously recording no motion, and nothing accounts for how she relocates into opposition while her positional register is explicitly frozen.

ev-045 ends with Trinity 'alarmed, having identified that someone is killing Neo' and knowing the threat is 'external and active' (off_screen_reactor). ev-046 opens her emotional entry as 'dread at having watched Neo nearly killed, with no read on whether he survived.' The shift from 'identified an active killer' to 'no read on whether he survived' is a knowledge regression presented as continuous; nothing in ev-046 records her losing the read she already had.

contradictions.detail: ev-045's affects_outside states Trinity 'now knows someone is killing Neo inside the Matrix' — a settled identification. ev-046's emotional entry for Trinity describes her as having 'no read on whether he survived,' and her arc is framed as newly acquiring the threat's 'specific object.' The earlier node asserts she already named the threat; the later node treats her as if she has not, contradicting the established knowledge state.

ev-045's affects_outside lists Trinity's off_screen_reactor as knowledge 'that will drive her later actions to reach and revive him.' ev-046 contradicts this forward momentum by opening her in a state of paralysis ('involuntary alarm,' 'no read on whether he survived,' 'dread') with no recorded trigger converting the driving knowledge from ev-045 into this frozen dread — the two nodes disagree on whether Trinity is already in motion toward Neo or only just beginning to react.

missing_links.detail: ev-045's affects_outside (off_screen_reactor) claims Trinity's knowledge 'will drive her later actions to reach and revive him.' ev-046 realises this drive beginning — she learns the deadline, measures it against Neo's survival, and moves to block the E.M.P. to protect him. Neither node states that ev-046 is where that promised drive begins to convert into action; the effect claimed upstream is realised downstream without being acknowledged at the seam.

ev-045 ends with Neo 'actively pursued by an unharmed Smith' toward the hotel, and its affects_outside (blocks_or_costs) spends 'Neo's remaining belief that escape ends the threat.' ev-046's off_screen_reactor states Neo 'is now racing a deadline he does not know exists.' The hand-off of Neo's pursued/fugitive state from ev-045 into the ticking-clock pressure of ev-046 is realised in the later node but neither node bridges how the Smith pursuit (ev-045's closing threat) relates to the Sentinel deadline (ev-046's threat) — two simultaneous pressures on Neo asserted without a linking acknowledgment.

state_breaks.detail: Neo's 'knowledge' register is marked moved=true in ev-047, and its exit state is 'Knows he is under direct fire and still has not been routed to an exit.' In ev-049 the same register is also marked moved=true, but its entry state is 'Acting on Tank's guidance, having just kicked in the wrong door on the first left instruction,' which describes a different knowledge condition (obedient action on guidance) with no recorded change accounting for the shift away from the 'under direct fire / not yet routed' state he exited ev-047 with.

Agent Brown's 'safety' register exits ev-049 with the state 'Eliminated — the second of the three Agents to fall,' while his 'physical' register exits the same event with 'Shot and destroyed, his gun still firing as his body falls.' Both are static (moved=false), yet the event's own positional triple and summary show Brown actively closing the distance through the building, appearing on the fire escape behind Neo, and descending toward the alley. A destroyed/eliminated body cannot be the active pursuer the event depicts, and no change is recorded to reconcile the lethal state with the active pursuit.

Agent Brown's 'physical' register exits ev-049 with 'Shot and destroyed, his gun still firing as his body falls' (moved=false), directly incompatible with the event's positional triple, which has Brown 'closing the distance behind Neo through the building and appears on the fire escape directly behind him.' The static destroyed-body state is not reconciled with the active movement the event records.

contradictions.detail: ev-049's summary and Agent Brown's positional triple depict Brown as the active pursuer who 'closes the distance through the building and appears on the fire escape directly behind Neo,' yet Brown's safety, physical, and relational registers all record him as already 'Eliminated / Shot and destroyed / a functioning member reporting status' with moved=false and no change. The event cannot simultaneously have Brown actively chasing Neo and already destroyed, and nothing in the nodes resolves which is true at the event's exit.

state_breaks.detail: Agent Brown (ev-049) → Agent Smith (ev-050) is not a state break because the entities differ; however, the earlier event's pursuer is 'Agent Brown' (a distinct, named Agent) while the later event's street Agent is 'Agent Smith'. No node records Brown's fate or Smith's arrival, so the substitution is unaccounted for — but this is a missing link / off-screen gap, not a single entity changing state. Flagged here only to note the discontinuity is real and unexplained in-node.

contradictions.detail: ev-049 Tank.safety exit: 'Safe inside the hovercraft but under imminent Sentinel threat that forbids using the EMP until Neo is out.' — ev-050 Tank.safety exit: 'Unaware of imminent danger; operating under the assumption the extraction can complete.' The earlier event records Tank as already aware of and constrained by the imminent Sentinel threat; the later event records him as unaware of that same threat. These are incompatible for the same entity across an adjacent join with no intervening account of him forgetting or being re-blindsided.

ev-049 Tank.safety entry/exit presupposes the EMP-embargo-under-threat state is active throughout ev-049; ev-050 Tank.knowledge/safety assert he has not registered the Sentinels' arrival and drives forward believing the window is open. The earlier node's claim that Tank is operating under an active Sentinel threat contradicts the later node's claim that he is unaware of that threat.

missing_links.detail: ev-049 affects_outside.off_screen_reactor explicitly holds unresolved 'the identity of the shooters' and whether 'the women react.' ev-050 introduces Agent Smith on the street with no node linking the earlier shooter/pursuer identity to Smith, nor accounting for the transition from 'Brown on the fire escape behind Neo' (ev-049) to 'Smith halting outside the hotel' (ev-050). Neither event states the connection.

ev-049 Tank announces Neo has 'nearly reached the fire escape' / is 'almost there' (extraction advancing); ev-050 opens with Tank 'loading the exit' / about to dial Neo out. The outward effect (Neo nearly at the exit enabling the dial-out) is realised in the later event but neither node states the causal through-line that Neo reached/entered the hotel and the exit is now being loaded — the connective tissue (Neo reaching the phone/exit) is absent between the two.

state_breaks.detail: Tank's safety/knowledge. In ev-050 Tank exits 'unaware of imminent danger,' explicitly not having registered the Sentinels' arrival. In ev-052 he is on the main deck 'exposed to the destruction raining down,' at the monitors, sharing a look with Morpheus over the reviving screens — a ship being physically breached and hammered. Nothing in either node accounts for Tank moving from unaware-at-his-station to present amid the active destruction of the ship.

Tank's knowledge. ev-050 holds Tank at 'knows the exit is found and Neo's path to it; believes the call can still get Neo out,' with the Sentinel arrival not yet registered by him. ev-052 has him reacting to the monitors reviving (Neo returning) with no recorded intermediate registration of the breach/aborted extraction. The pivot from running a live extraction to witnessing Neo's death-and-revival during the ship's destruction is unaccounted for.

Neo. ev-050's off_screen_reactor places Neo 'still inside the hotel... racing toward' his exit as it's destroyed. ev-052 opens with Neo already dead on the ship's main deck, confirmed by Agent Brown. The nodes record neither his jacking-out nor his collapse from the hotel gunfire, so the transition from 'running, cut off from exit' to 'corpse on the deck' is unaccounted for.

missing_links.detail: ev-050's off_screen_reactor explicitly claims Neo is 'cut off from his exit — the way out he was racing toward is being destroyed from the ship's end.' ev-052 plainly realises this: Neo is dead on the deck, having been shot in the hotel, with Agent Brown reporting 'He's gone.' Neither node states that the aborted/destructed extraction caused Neo's death in the Matrix, so the claimed effect is realised without being named as the link between them.

state_breaks.detail: The LATER event's summary and Neo's relational register show the crew (Tank, Morpheus, Trinity) watching the monitors and seeing live images of Neo, but the EARLIER event's off_screen_reactor explicitly records Morpheus's EMP decision as 'left hanging... the event does not resolve whether he fires it,' and his knowledge register exits 'poised to trigger the EMP' with no resolution. The LATER event has the crew calmly watching a revelation with no accounting for Morpheus having lowered/abandoned the EMP switch he was poised to trigger, nor any record of the sentinel threat that motivated it being resolved or paused.

The LATER event's affects_outside.blocks_or_costs introduces 'The ship is struck by an explosion at the moment of the crew's triumph,' and Tank/Morpheus/Trinity safety registers all move from 'Absorbed in awe' to 'Jolted by a violent explosion.' The EARLIER event's safety registers for Tank, Morpheus, and Trinity all record 'destruction raining down around' them as ongoing and unchanged. The LATER event treats the crew's immediate prior state as 'awe' at the monitors with no continuity to the 'destruction raining down' safety state the EARLIER event locked in — the awe state is presented as if the surrounding destruction were not already ongoing, leaving the relationship between the two safety conditions (ongoing rain of destruction vs. a single new explosion) unaccounted.

Same as Tank: the EARLIER event locks Morpheus's safety as 'Exposed to the destruction raining down around the ship' (moved:false), but the LATER event's safety register enters him 'Absorbed in awe at the monitors coming alive' — a state that ignores the ongoing destruction the earlier event established, then moves him to 'Jolted by a violent explosion.' The awe entry is incompatible with the destruction exposure that should still be in force.

Same as Tank/Morpheus: the EARLIER event locks Trinity's safety as 'Exposed to destruction raining down around her on the main deck' (moved:false), but the LATER event enters her safety as 'Absorbed in awe at the monitors coming alive,' then moves to 'Jolted by a violent explosion,' with no accounting for the transition from the ongoing destruction-exposure state.

contradictions.detail: The EARLIER event's Neo knowledge/emotional registers exit 'Dependent on Tank's real-time correction; following the revised route out of the building' and 'Under acute stress, still trying to escape while being shot at' — these are carryover states from an earlier chase, yet the EARLIER event's own Neo scenes place him dead/unconscious on the ship. The LATER event enters Neo as 'Wounded, holding his chest and struggling to his feet after being shot down' in the hall, fighting the Agents. The two events place Neo in two different locations/situations simultaneously (dead on the ship vs. wounded-and-fighting in the hall) with no bridge, and the EARLIER event's stale knowledge/emotional exits contradict the LATER event's entry conditions.

missing_links.detail: The EARLIER event's affects_outside.off_screen_reactor flags 'Morpheus's decision whether to trigger the EMP... is left hanging' as an unresolved outward effect. The LATER event plainly realises the resolution of that hanging thread — the crew is shown safe, absorbed in awe at the monitors, with no sentinels overwhelming them and Morpheus no longer at the switch — yet neither node states that Morpheus chose not to fire (or was interrupted from firing) the EMP. The realisation of the hanging EMP decision is silent.

state_breaks.detail: Trinity's 'safety' exit in ev-053 is 'Jolted by a violent explosion aboard the ship — awe replaced by imminent danger,' but her 'safety' entry in ev-054 is 'Watching Neo's awakening with the others, unthreatened,' with no account of how the danger passed and the deck returned to calm.

Morpheus's 'safety' exit in ev-053 is 'Jolted by a violent explosion aboard the ship — the triumph undercut by imminent destruction,' but his 'safety' entry in ev-054 is 'Present on the deck, unthreatened,' with nothing accounting for the return to safety.

Trinity's 'emotional' entry in ev-054 is 'Under direct attack on a ship being destroyed' (a state), while her 'safety' entry is identical wording and also 'moved: true'; the emotional register appears to reuse the safety state's text rather than record a distinct emotional change, and its 'moved: false' contradicts the claim that she is now under attack.

contradictions.detail: ev-053 ends with the ship rocked by an explosion that knocks the story 'from revelation into survival and endangering everyone aboard,' yet ev-054 opens with Trinity and Morpheus 'unthreatened' and calmly watching Neo's awakening — the earlier event's closing threat is treated as absent at the later event's start with no bridging beat.

state_breaks.detail: Neo's safety/positional state. The EARLIER event ends with Neo diving for the ringing phone as the exit from a ship being overrun and destroyed by sentinels, with the EMP having just killed the machines. The LATER event opens with Neo dead/just killed and revived, lying still in the darkness of the hovercraft while Trinity keeps vigil over his corpse. Nothing between the two nodes accounts for how Neo went from diving toward the exit to being dead (killed) and lying in the hovercraft. The EMP would also plausibly have disabled the ship/phone exit, but neither node bridges the transition from escape-in-progress to corpse-on-a-table.

Trinity's safety/positional state. The EARLIER event ends with Trinity commanding the crew's last move off a ship being overrun and destroyed, actively directing the escape. The LATER event opens with Trinity in a private, still, dark hovercraft keeping vigil over Neo's body, bent over him. Nothing accounts for her transition from directing an escape off a dying ship to a sealed, safe, private reunion setting in the hovercraft.

Morpheus and the rest of the crew. The EARLIER event has Morpheus triggering the EMP and the crew converging on the phone to escape; the LATER event states only 'the two humans alive' in the hovercraft, with no mention of Morpheus or any other crew member. Whether they escaped, survived, or were lost is not carried across.

contradictions.detail: The EARLIER event's setting is a hovercraft being overrun and destroyed by sentinels (the ship is 'dead' after the EMP). The LATER event describes a 'still, dark hovercraft' that is a 'sealed, private, shielded space' with 'only the two humans alive' — a calm, intact, safe environment. The two nodes present incompatible conditions of the same vessel (being destroyed vs. intact and sealed) with no transition accounting for the change. This is a continuity break that reads as a contradiction of setting state across the join.
